agent/src/base/tools/_lib.ts.summary: Shared plumbing for the custom sandboxed tools: default byte/timeout/row/file limits, a dependency-free JSON-line tool logger, truncation helpers that mark omitted bytes explicitly, the withToolLog timing wrapper and toolError message formatting.

agent/src/base/tools/file-tools.ts.summary: Sandboxed file toolkit (FileTools class and createFileTools) replacing the sunset community FileManagementToolkit: read_file, write_file, list_directory and delete_file with absolute-root validation, symlink-canonicalised containment checks, size

agent/src/base/tools/index.ts.summary: Aggregator for the custom sandboxed tools: filterTools applies allow/deny name rules and getAllTools/getAllToolsAsync compose the optional shell tool plus required file, http and sql toolkits with the always-included upsert_memory tool; also

agent/src/base/tools/mcp-client.ts.summary: Lazily constructs a MultiServerMCPClient for the backend /mcp endpoint (BACKEND_MCP_URL, default http://localhost:3001/mcp) and exposes loadSessionManagerTools to fetch the remote session-manager tools.

agent/src/base/tools/runtime.ts.summary: Builds the tool set for a graph invocation: buildRuntimeTools calls getAllToolsAsync with a default sandbox config and applies the allow/deny lists from the runtime configuration.

agent/src/base/tools/shell-tool.ts.summary: The shell tool (createShellTool): a shell-free restricted command runner that tokenizes input into argv, rejects shell metacharacters such as ;, &&, |, $(), backticks and redirects, enforces a command whitelist/cwd/timeout and returns stdout, stderr

agent/src/base/tools/upsert-mem.ts.summary: The upsert_memory tool: writes or updates a user memory in the LangGraph store namespace [memories, userId], reading store and configuration from ToolRuntime so a single instance can be reused by ToolNode.

bin/puna.mjs.summary: Executable entry point for the puna CLI: dispatches the init and serve subcommands to src/init.js and src/serve.js and prints usage help for -h/--help or unknown commands.

dev.sh.summary: Development launcher that runs the backend and frontend via bun and the agent via npm concurrently with colour-prefixed, line-buffered output, auto-restarts crashed services and kills all children on Ctrl-C/exit.

install.sh.summary: Repo installer: runs bun install at the root for packages/* plus backend and frontend, then standalone npm install inside agent/ for the native better-sqlite3 binding, supporting --skip-if-installed and --force and logging to .puna/install-*.log.

src/init.js.summary: Implementation of puna init: bootstraps the global config at ~/.config/.puna with bundled agent templates (semar, cepot, dawala, gareng) and skill templates (create-agent, create-skill, planning), then creates or refreshes a project-local .puna

src/serve.js.summary: Implementation of puna serve: finds the nearest .puna workspace by walking up from cwd, loads and validates its config, scans plans and the layered local/global agents and skills, prints a context banner, and spawns the backend/agent/frontend dev

src/ulid.js.summary: Minimal dependency-free ULID generator (Crockford base32, 10-char timestamp plus 16-char randomness) whose workspaceId() helper produces the ws_ prefixed ids stored in .puna/config.json.

packages/cli/bin/puna-plugin.mjs.summary: Executable entrypoint for the puna-plugin CLI: dynamically imports ../src/index.js and prints the CLI version; currently a Fase 0 stub whose real commands (plugin create/dev/build) land in Fase 7.

packages/sdk-frontend/src/badge.tsx.summary: PluginSourceBadge React component: small inline tag showing a plugin's origin layer (workspace-local/workspace-global/system-global) in layer-specific colors with an optional muted kind suffix; exports PluginSourceBadge and PluginSourceBadgeProps.

packages/sdk-frontend/src/host.tsx.summary: Core frontend plugin host: PluginHostProvider owns registry state and a loader-result component cache, LoadedPluginComponent lazily renders a plugin slot, and hooks (usePluginRegistry, usePluginLeftBarItems, usePluginFooterBarItems,

packages/sdk-shared/src/index.ts.summary: Barrel entry for @puna/sdk-shared re-exporting the source and manifest modules, serving as the single source of truth for plugin schemas/types shared by backend parsing and frontend typing.

packages/sdk-shared/src/source.ts.summary: Defines the PluginSource zod enum classifying where a discovered plugin directory came from (workspace-local, workspace-global, system-global), with local-wins conflict policy documented for discovery.

templates/plugin/logging-hook/backend/in.summary: Logging-hook plugin template backend stub exporting no-op beforeNode/afterNode lifecycle hooks (as named and default exports); real hook logic is slated for Fase 5.

templates/plugin/mermaid-renderer/backen.summary: Placeholder backend module for the UI-only mermaid-renderer plugin template; exports an empty default object for symmetry since capabilities.backendHooks is not declared.

templates/plugin/research-agent/graphs/r.summary: Research-agent graph template exporting a stub researchGraph object with empty nodes/edges (default export) as a placeholder for the real LangGraph subgraph planned for Fase 6.
